target.statement: ToRA-CODE-7B achieves 44.6% accuracy on the MATH test set (competition-level math problems)

compute.basis: Reproducing the headline number requires fine-tuning a 7B LLaMA-2/CodeLLaMA model on the 69k-annotation ToRA-CORPUS (which itself was generated by GPT-4 API calls) plus output-space shaping, then running inference with tool execution on the full MATH test set; this is a multi-hour GPU training run, not feasible on a CPU-only laptop.

blockers: Fine-tuning a 7B LLM requires a GPU (24GB+ VRAM) and many GPU-hours
ToRA-CORPUS training data was synthesized via GPT-4 API (closed model, costly)
Output-space shaping requires sampling 64 trajectories per question and a 34B teacher model for correction
Full reproduction needs the 7B base model plus tool-execution environment (sympy, etc.)
title: ToRA: A Tool-Integrated Reasoning Agent for Mathematical Problem Solving
